column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(30)) for a security monitoring record (e.g., 'SM-xyz123').
An enum (SecurityAuditStatus_enum) describing the system's last security audit result (Warning, Pass, Fail).
An INT listing how many security measures are in place (e.g., 8).
An enum (EncryptionStrength_enum) describing encryption (Strong, Military-grade, Standard).
An enum (AuthenticationMethod_enum) used for system auth (Basic, 2FA, Multi-factor).
An enum (DataProtectionLevel_enum) reflecting data handling (Maximum, Enhanced, Basic).
An enum (AlertSev_enum) for alert severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical).
An enum (AlertCategory_enum) describing alert focus (Pattern, Transaction, Behavior, Security).
A NUMERIC(4,2) (0–99.99) for confidence in each alert (e.g., 85.20).
FK referencing RiskAnalysis(RiskRegistry). Links monitoring data to a risk profile.
FK referencing Communication(CommRegistry) if relevant security logs exist.

JSONB column. A collection of scores related to threat intelligence integration, detection capabilities, anonymity assessment, and analytical pattern matching from security monitoring.
Fields: {"anomaly_detection_score":"A NUMERIC(5,3) anomaly detection rating (e.g., 423.101).","anonymity_level":"An enum (AnonLevel_enum) describing anonymity (Low, Medium, High).","behavioral_analysis_score":"A NUMERIC(5,2) rating behavior-based threat detection (e.g., 88.25).","detection_evasion_score":"A NUMERIC(5,2) for how well the system evades detection (e.g., 60.15).","event_correlation_strength":"A NUMERIC(5,3) measuring cross-event correlation (e.g., 123.456).","ml_confidence_score":"A NUMERIC(5,3) ML detection confidence (0–999.999) (e.g., 567.842).","pattern_matching_score":"A NUMERIC(4,2) (0–99.99) for pattern-matching adequacy (e.g., 75.30).","threat_intelligence_score":"A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring usage of threat intel (e.g., 85.20).","traceability_score":"A NUMERIC(5,3) (0–999.999) rating how traceable user actions are (e.g., 245.671)."}
